mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 67 degrees under partly cloudy skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight, keep your eyes on the skies as the International Space Station makes an appearance! At 7:37 PM, look to the West Northwest over Cross Plains and track it moving across the sky toward the Northeast near Madison.

The City of Verona has officially adopted its 2026 Comprehensive Plan, titled Envision Verona. This document serves as a long-term guide for future city growth, covering essential topics like housing, transportation, and natural resources, based on extensive community feedback.

There is plenty to do in town. Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Looking further ahead, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and the Dane County Farmers Market both kick off this Friday.

In a report from September 5th, Verona police responded to a strange situation where multiple vehicles on several streets were found with cheese slices on their windshields, identified as a viral social media prank called the Dairy Dare.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM today. Please note that the store is currently undergoing a remodel, so the flavor of the day is not available at this time.
